summary: TypeScript tool calling docs/example throws JSON parse error when tool_call arguments arrive as partial JSON deltas
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports that the TypeScript tool-calling example (docs snippet / README style) intermittently throws `SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input` when parsing tool arguments during streaming.

Impact:
- Customer is unable to reliably use tool calling with streaming in Node/TS.
- Causes unhandled promise rejection and tool dispatch never runs.

Customer report:
- Using Redwood TypeScript SDK in a Next.js API route.
- Copied the tool calling snippet from docs ("Tools" page) and adapted it to parse `toolCallDelta.arguments` as JSON.
- Error appears more frequently for larger argument objects / when the model emits arguments over multiple deltas.

Environment:
- Node: 18.19.0
- Runtime: Next.js 14 (serverless function)
- SDK: @redwood-inference/sdk v0.14.2 (per customer)
- Region: us-east

Steps to reproduce:
1) Call chat completion with tools enabled and streaming on.
2) In the stream loop, attempt `JSON.parse(delta.tool_call.arguments)` on each tool-call delta.
3) Observe occasional parse failure when `arguments` is not complete JSON yet.

Observed error (customer snippet):
```
SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input
    at JSON.parse (<anonymous>)
    at onToolDelta (…/route.ts:88:23)
```

Notes:
This appears consistent with gateway semantics where tool-call arguments may arrive in multiple incremental deltas (valid prefix but invalid JSON until final chunk). Example should accumulate argument text per tool_call_id and only parse once the tool call is finalized.

Requested outcome:
- Update docs + TS example to reflect correct delta handling.
- Add regression test so the snippet fails CI if it ever reverts to parsing partial JSON.

Attachments/logs:
- Customer provided a sample event sequence in comment thread (redacted).

- Only JSON.parse when the tool call is complete (when we receive the final tool call payload / end of stream message).
- Add a regression test that feeds partial deltas and asserts parsing only happens at finalization.

resolution:
Root cause: Docs/TypeScript example pattern implied parsing `tool_call.arguments` on each streaming delta. Gateway streams tool-call arguments as incremental text fragments; intermediate fragments can be invalid JSON.

Fix:
- Updated TS tool-calling example to accumulate argument deltas per `tool_call_id` and parse only upon finalization.
- Added regression test to ensure partial JSON deltas do not trigger parse attempts.

Workaround (immediate): Buffer argument fragments and defer JSON.parse until end-of-tool-call / end-of-stream.

Customer confirmation: Northwind Analytics confirmed workaround and then confirmed updated snippet resolves the issue.
internal_notes: This is also aligned with the canonical event model work (tool call delta semantics). If we see more of these, consider adding an SDK helper utility (e.g., `ToolCallAccumulator`) but keep public API stable per project constraints.
